claim_rules.mrr_superiority: May be stated only when the full paired-bootstrap 95% CI for candidate-v6 minus comparator is strictly above 0.
claim_rules.mrr_noninferiority: May be stated only when the lower bound of the paired-bootstrap 95% CI for candidate-v6 minus comparator is >= -0.03.
claim_rules.algorithm_parity_default: NO unless a separate preregistered parity/equivalence criterion exists and passes; this protocol does not create one post hoc.

candidate_v6_gate_e_statistics.v6_vs_v2: Report paired MRR delta, 95% CI, W/T/L and retrieval guardrail verdict.
candidate_v6_gate_e_statistics.v6_vs_exact_a_mem: Report paired MRR delta, 95% CI, W/T/L and frozen non-inferiority/superiority verdicts without inflating claims.
candidate_v6_gate_e_statistics.abstention: Report case counts and Wilson 95% CIs for Candidate-v6, Candidate-v2 and exact A-MEM when outputs exist.
